main.summary: Coordinates segmented transfer session operations backed by PostgreSQL state and Azure Blob payloads.

field.name: sessions
field.summary: Transfer-session state and payload store used by the segmented service.

field.name: registry
field.summary: Registry used to track active transfer sessions.

field.name: coordinator
field.summary: Coordinator used to acquire transfer mutation scopes.

field.name: publications
field.summary: Publication-transfer store used to manage publication journals.

field.name: storageContext
field.summary: Request-scoped authorized storage context that supplies the catalog binding.

field.name: grainFactory
field.summary: Orleans client factory used to read catalog-owned item identity and deletion state.

field.name: publishedSource
field.summary: Published transfer source used to resolve published payloads and snapshots.

constructor.name: DataControlSegmentedTransferService
constructor.param: Orleans client factory used to read catalog-owned item state.

method.name: LoadRequiredManifest
method.summary: Loads and validates the manifest identity and current catalog-owned item instance token for a segmented transfer session.

method.name: LoadRequiredManifestForWrite
method.summary: Loads a segmented transfer manifest and validates its identity and catalog-owned item instance token.
method.param: When true, load the lightweight write manifest without realized coverage; otherwise load and normalize coverage.

method.name: TouchSessionActivity
method.summary: Renews the server-observed activity time for a successfully read, queried, or reopened segmented transfer session.
method.exception: The transfer session no longer exists.

method.name: CreateManifest
method.summary: Creates the initial manifest for a segmented upload session bound to the active catalog item token or a fresh candidate token.
method.param: Item instance token assigned to the upload.

method.name: CreateStagedReadManifest
method.summary: Creates a staged-read manifest bound to the same item instance token as its existing source manifest.

method.name: CreatePublishedReadManifest
method.summary: Creates a published-read manifest bound to the item instance token recorded by the validated published snapshot.

method.name: LoadRequiredPublishedSnapshot
method.summary: Loads and validates a published snapshot for the expected item instance token.

method.name: CreateRange
method.summary: Creates a transfer range from an offset and length.

method.name: ValidateIdentity
method.summary: Validates that a transfer identity contains non-empty session and item identifiers.

method.name: ValidateManifestIdentity
method.summary: Validates that a manifest belongs to the expected session and item and carries a non-empty item instance token.

method.name: ValidateMutationScope
method.summary: Validates that a mutation scope belongs to the expected session and item.

method.name: ValidateAbortRequest
method.summary: Validates an abort request.

method.name: ValidateRemoveRequest
method.summary: Validates that a remove request contains non-empty session and item identifiers.

method.name: ValidateOpenGetRequest
method.summary: Validates an open-get request.

method.name: ValidateReOpenGetRequest
method.summary: Validates a reopen-get request.

method.name: ValidateReOpenRequest
method.summary: Validates a reopen-upload request.

method.name: ValidateGetTransferSegmentRequest
method.summary: Validates a segmented transfer segment-read request.

method.name: ValidateOpenRequest
method.summary: Validates an open-upload request and its object payload.

method.name: ValidatePublishRequest
method.summary: Validates a segmented publication request.

method.name: ValidatePutRequest
method.summary: Validates a segmented transfer segment-write request and payload for atomic writes and identical replay behavior.

method.name: ValidateSegmentLength
method.summary: Validates a segment length against the manifest policy and configured minimum and maximum enforcement settings.
method.param: Transfer manifest containing the segment-size policy.

method.name: ValidateSessionWritable
method.summary: Validates that a manifest permits write operations.

method.name: ValidateAbortableSession
method.summary: Validates that a segmented upload session is open or complete and can be aborted.

method.name: ValidateSessionReadable
method.summary: Validates that a manifest permits read operations.

method.name: ValidateManifestHashes
method.summary: Validates the object hash and stream length recorded in a manifest.

method.name: ValidatePublishedSnapshot
method.summary: Validates that a published snapshot matches the requested item instance token and that its object payload matches its hash.

method.name: ValidatePublishedSnapshotIdentity
method.summary: Validates that a published snapshot matches the item instance token, stream length, object hash, and integrity recorded in a transfer manifest.
method.param: Transfer manifest whose published identity and integrity must match the snapshot.
